name: @sachikonye/sbs
description: Systems Biology Shaders (SBS) DSL runtime: compile .sbs source to a cellular circuit, render the S-entropy observation on WebGL2 (CPU fallback), extract coherence/visibility metrics. Public surface is runSBS(source).
author: Kundai Farai Sachikonye <kundai.sachikonye@wzw.tum.de>
